findings.text: Early measured launch probe publishes availability of the trusted boot shared page. With no address in boot parameters the global stays unset. After reservation and identity checks the lane exposes a mapped shared page pointer or leaves it cleared to signal absence.

Trusted boot shared page acceptance requires nonzero physical address recorded as reserved memory, identifier match against the expected trusted identifier, and version at or above the minimum supported generation. Any mismatch or low version forces the absent state with a diagnostic.

Early timestamp counter initialization is a boot entry with no effect without counter support or on early uniform virtualized multichassis systems. On eligible systems its contract covers secure counter preparation, frequency discovery, and scheduler clock enablement as prerequisites for timekeeping.

Frequency discovery has early and late modes with distinct sources. Early mode consults platform calibration hooks with optional preseeded timestamp rate. Late mode uses timer based calibration and expects native CPU calibration. Reconciliation treats nonzero timestamp rate as authoritative, repairs divergent CPU rate, and fails when no timestamp rate results.

Timer calibration retains the smallest observed rate across repeated attempts. Agreement between interval timer result and high precision or power management reference inside a ten percent tolerance selects the reference as final. Persistent disagreement, missing sources, or total failure select defined fallbacks including timer only, reference only, or disabled counter.

Interval timer sampling is sensitive to firmware interrupts and virtualization delay. Short sample counts and excessive spread between fastest and slowest port reads invalidate an attempt. Reference captures exceeding a frequency derived latency threshold are discarded through sentinel maxima rather than trusted.

Timer calibration excludes interrupts around paired timestamp and reference captures. Cycle to nanosecond readers are lock free through a latched sequence counter with dual parameter copies sampled on stable sequence. Writers publish both copies under latch begin and end primitives. Nanosecond conversion additionally suppresses preemption and tracing around the read.

Per processor time conversion state comprises a latch sequence plus two identical parameter sets each holding offset, multiplier, and shift. Adjustment tracking per processor holds a boot value, a package adjusted value, a next verification time, and a warning flag used on the hotplug path.

Conversion parameter updates preserve time continuity by deriving the new offset from the current cycle count translated through prior parameters. A shift value that would exceed the performance user page limit is reduced by one with compensating halving of the multiplier.

Boot processor adjustment handling sanitizes only the local first member view and never compares across packages. Hotplug handling distinguishes first member in a package, sanitized locally, from later members, forced to the established package adjusted value and then exempted from further synchronization testing.

On the boot processor a nonzero initial adjustment is forced to zero with a firmware diagnostic unless asynchronous package resets are declared, in which case the nonzero value is retained and reported. Non boot first members retain their boot value as package baseline.

Unwinder initialization validates table presence and size consistency then builds a block indexed search accelerator over sorted address and entry tables. Any size mismatch, count mismatch, or failed accelerator probe leaves the unwinder disabled.
Virtual symmetric multiprocessing initialization detects the platform, ends silently on nonmatching hardware, otherwise enforces a processor count cap and programs the foundation control register.

Virtual platform detection is cached after first evaluation and requires early PCI access plus vendor and device match at the legacy bridge function. The fallback build variant unconditionally reports absent and performs no control programming.
Video memory reservation covers start 0xa0000 end 0xbffff marked busy memory under Video RAM area name and requested against the main memory resource during 32 bit reservation.
Trusted boot shared page minimum accepted version is five. The page is accessed through a dedicated fixed mapping slot reserved for this purpose.

Interval timer calibration programs channel two through control and data ports with least then most significant latch bytes, adjusts gate and speaker control through the system port, and polls the output bit to detect countdown completion. Without legacy interrupt controller hardware the routine performs equivalent delay and reports no measurement.

High precision reference arithmetic compensates 32 bit counter wrap and scales by the high precision period to microseconds before dividing the timestamp delta. Power management reference arithmetic compensates its defined rollover range and scales by its fixed ticks per second. Empty reference pairs yield the maximum unsigned result.
Loop count per timer tick derives from timestamp frequency in kilohertz scaled to hertz then divided by the kernel tick rate.

Timestamp adjustment state is accessed through the architected adjustment register with per processor boot and adjusted values. Next verification is scheduled one second of timer ticks after sampling.

Virtual platform control lives at bus zero device 31 function zero base register zero, mapped for eight bytes holding capability and control words. Optional routing optimization clears bit eight when capability and control both advertise it and may suppress user affinity changes. Topology capping decodes node shift and processor mask from a dedicated register with zero shift interpreted as eight.

Per processor offset table holds one unsigned entry per possible processor and becomes read only after initialization. First chunk reservation is either the module reservation size or zero depending on build configuration. Log output from this unit carries its build module name as prefix.

Public early interfaces in this lane comprise trusted boot probing, early timestamp initialization, unwinder initialization, virtual platform initialization, 32 bit resource reservation, hotplug eligibility query, per processor offset table, and lock free conversion read.

Only processors numbered above zero are reported hotpluggable. Panic reporting registers a notifier that dumps the kernel relocation offset. Non uniform memory initialization is required only when distinct online nodes back different possible processors.

Trusted boot mapping verifies reservation type before fixed mapping to reduce risk that a corrupt address causes a fault. Frequency discovery warns when invoked after rates are already set or late with non native hooks. Missing mapping during virtual capping warns and aborts the cap.

Unwinder metadata consists of parallel sorted tables of addresses and entries plus a block lookup array storing entry indices for range starts and a terminal range end. Initialization records block count from linker provided lookup bounds.

Scheduler clock readiness combines loop calibration with delay selection, adjustment sanitation, boot processor conversion initialization from current frequency and counter value, and activation of the timestamp static branch.
